name: Game Tools
description: Helpers for the games you play, one per sidebar entry. Steam: price history. CS2: the market with a selling calculator, and overlays for translated chat and a bomb timer. Roblox: Mafia role counting. Minecraft: 29 tools for players, admins and developers — enchant optimizer, shape and map art generators, guides, and command and datapack generators.

zh.name: 游戏工具
